extra_records.decision: retain authorial mathematical limitation; discuss in guide
extra_records.reason: The source restricts ordinary products to finite ones while retracting a more general limit claim. Arbitrary products also exist in the homotopy category, represented by products of Kan complexes; the source wording is preserved.
